# Paying a lot into a pension? Check your tapered annual allowance, carry forward and any tax charge.

> Free UK pension annual allowance calculator: your tapered allowance for incomes over £260,000, carry forward from the last three years, how much you can still pay in, and the tax charge on any excess. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
